title: DAppXchange BoardSuite
tagline: Unite, Govern, Exchange: Empowering DApps Through Collective Decision-Making
description:
### Co-ownership of Organization Wallets 👥💼

Empowering shared wallet management, our platform simplifies multi-signature wallet coordination using Gnosis Safe Auth Kit. This ensures transparent and accountable transactions by requiring multiple authorized approvals, streamlining organizational financial operations.

### Decentralized Governance for Organizations 🌐🏛️

Revolutionizing traditional governance, our decentralized model fosters transparency and inclusivity. It enables stakeholders to engage in transparent decision-making processes, leveraging blockchain technology for fair voting mechanisms and collective decision-making within organizations.

### Gasless and Secure Token Swaps 🔄🛡️

Enhancing DeFi accessibility, our platform offers gasless token swaps via 1inch Fusion API. By optimizing exchanges and prioritizing security, we ensure a seamless user experience while mitigating transaction costs and addressing key concerns related to private key management.

how_its_made:
We were unable to deploy 1inch network's fusion SDK since it does not support any testnets

Safe Auth kit uses client side rendering which interferes with NextJS Server side rendering and causes issues in deployment. This caused CORS issues, due to which we were unable to utilize Safe API kit to the fullest
